calls.response_tail:
Fixed the bug in [`Command.make_context`](file:///work/src/click/core.py#L1130-L1136) where `ctx.close()` was never called if `self.parse_args(ctx, args)` raised an exception (such as `Exit` from an eager option like `--help` or a custom callback calling `ctx.exit()`).

### Root Cause
`Command.make_context` enters `with ctx.scope(cleanup=False):` while calling `self.parse_args(ctx, args)`. When `parse_args` raises an exception, `make_context` never returns `ctx` to the caller (e.g. `with self.make_context(...) as ctx:` in `Command.main`), so `ctx.close()` was skipped and any callbacks registered via `ctx.call_on_close()` were never invoked.

### Fix
Wrapped `self.parse_args(ctx, args)` in a `try ... except BaseException:` block inside `with ctx.scope(cleanup=False):` in [src/click/core.py](file:///work/src/click/core.py#L1130-L1136) so `ctx.close()` is called before the exception propagates and before `ctx` is popped from the context stack.

### Verification
Ran `./venv/bin/python -m pytest -vv tests/test_context.py`: all 27 tests in [tests/test_context.py](file:///work/tests/test_context.py) passed, including `test_no_state_leaks` and both `test_multiple_eager_callbacks` cases.
